name: Rheinmetall AG
summary: Operating globally, Rheinmetall AG (RNMBY) specializes in delivering cutting-edge technologies across the mobility and security domains, structured into Vehicle Systems, Weapon and Ammunition, Electronic Solutions, Sensors and Actuators, and Materials and Trade divisions. Originally established in 1889 as Rheinmetall Berlin AG, its corporate headquarters are located in Düsseldorf, Germany.
